name: timer
description: Set, list or cancel a countdown timer. Lancer announces it out loud himself when it finishes, so this is the right tool whenever someone wants to be told when an amount of time has passed -- cooking, laundry, a study break, 'remind me in ten minutes'. Give the duration exactly as the person said it.

action.description: set a new timer, list what is running, or cancel one. Defaults to set.

duration.description: How long, in the words the person used: '5 minutes', 'an hour and a half', '90 seconds'. Required when setting.

label.description: What the timer is for, if they said: 'pasta', 'laundry'. Used to tell timers apart and to cancel one by name.
